name: personal-coach
description: Personal-use companion for basic-harness: a structured way for Claude to act as your personal assistant, business mentor, and reflective psychologist-style listener. Builds a persistent profile of you so the help compounds across sessions. Not a replacement for a real therapist. News digest and fintech legal triage have moved to their own plugins (news-digest, fintech-legal-advisor) — install those alongside if you want either feature.
